source_policy: explicit run arguments and input hashes
purpose: diagnose implementability and timing sensitivity of unvalidated signal candidates; not accepted principal inference
model: physiology_outcome ~ VAS + person fixed effects + categorical block
hb_outcome: within-person standardized block means; sample SD across eligible blocks in each specification; zero SD excluded; SD units/VAS
rmssd_outcome: ms of candidate RR differences, not verified NN
sensitivity: all frozen offsets/drifts and A/B; nominal Hb mask/coverage/common-set settings; point estimates and coverage, no scenario selection
bootstrap_unit: whole true person; multiplicity weights equivalent to separately indexed bootstrap copies for person FE
scale_limitation: within-person standardization changes estimand and does not establish common Hb concentration units
